proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6835 *dhūḍi includes Oriya dhuḷi and regional dhūl/dhūṛ dust. Simple dhuli/dhuḍ forms fit this family; reduplicated dhudhar needs separate morphology. Exact survey form dɦuli is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
